See also: harddisk and hårddisk

English

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • HD (abbreviation), hard disc, harddisk

Pronunciation

[edit]
This entry needs pronunciation information. If you are familiar with the IPA or enPR then please add some!
  • Audio (Southern England):(file)

Noun

[edit]

hard disk (plural hard disks)

  2. (computer hardware) One of a series of parallel magnetic recording disks in a drive unit, used for the recording and retrieval of digital information; used especially in personal computers.
    Synonyms: fixed disk, hard disk drive, hard drive, spinning rust (humorous), Winchester disk (dated)
  3. (computer hardware) The unit itself, and all the disks within it.

[edit]

Borrowed from English hard disk.

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

  1. hard disk, hard drive
    Synonym: pevný disk
